sanskrit: kad i̱tthā nṝm̐ḥ pātra̍ṁ devaya̱tāṁ śrava̱d giro̱ aṅgi̍rasāṁ tura̱ṇyan | pra yad āna̱ḍ viśa̱ ā ha̱rmyasyo̱ru kra̍ṁsate adhva̱re yaja̍traḥ ||
english: How does he who is swift become the worthy vessel of god-seeking men, hearing the hymns of the Aṅgirasas? When he advances into the clans from the dwelling-place, the adorable one strides broadly at the sacrifice.

sanskrit: stambhī̍d dha̱ dyāṁ sa dha̱ruṇa̍m pruṣāyad ṛ̱bhur vājā̍ya̱ dravi̍ṇa̱ṁ naro̱ goḥ | anu̍ sva̱jām ma̍hi̱ṣaś ca̍kṣata̱ vrām menā̱m aśva̍sya̱ pari̍ mā̱tara̱ṁ goḥ ||
english: He indeed propped up heaven as its support; the skilful Ṛbhu sprinkled wealth in cattle for the heroes at the prize-contest. The great bull looked upon its own kind, the beloved companion, the mother of the horse — the cow.

sanskrit: nakṣa̱d dhava̍m aru̱ṇīḥ pū̱rvyaṁ rāṭ tu̱ro vi̱śām aṅgi̍rasā̱m anu̱ dyūn | takṣa̱d vajra̱ṁ niyu̍taṁ ta̱stambha̱d dyāṁ catu̍ṣpade̱ naryā̍ya dvi̱pāde̍ ||
english: The ruddy one, the primeval king, shall come swiftly to the call, following the days of the Aṅgirasa clans. He fashioned the thunderbolt with its team of steeds and propped up heaven — for the four-footed and the two-footed, for the hero's sake.

sanskrit: a̱sya made̍ sva̱rya̍ṁ dā ṛ̱tāyāpī̍vṛtam u̱sriyā̍ṇā̱m anī̍kam | yad dha̍ pra̱sarge̍ trika̱kum ni̱varta̱d apa̱ druho̱ mānu̍ṣasya̱ duro̍ vaḥ ||
english: In his exhilaration he gave heavenly light to Ṛta — the host of the dawn-cows whose faces were veiled. When at the release he turned back Trikakubh, he drove away from you the guiles of mortal deceit.

sanskrit: tubhya̱m payo̱ yat pi̱tarā̱v anī̍tā̱ṁ rādha̍ḥ su̱reta̍s tu̱raṇe̍ bhura̱ṇyū | śuci̱ yat te̱ rekṇa̱ āya̍janta saba̱rdughā̍yā̱ḥ paya̍ u̱sriyā̍yāḥ ||
english: The milk that the two parents brought to you, O swift and active one — the boon of good seed — that was your endowment; the pure wealth they offered you: the milk of the dawn-cow that yields together with the Sun.

sanskrit: adha̱ pra ja̍jñe ta̱raṇi̍r mamattu̱ pra ro̍cy a̱syā u̱ṣaso̱ na sūra̍ḥ | indu̱r yebhi̱r āṣṭa̱ svedu̍havyaiḥ sru̱veṇa̍ si̱ñcañ ja̱raṇā̱bhi dhāma̍ ||
english: Then the swift one was born and rejoiced; he blazed forth like the Sun at this Dawn. Indu struck with those offerings that bring sweat, pouring with the ladle toward the ancient dwelling.

sanskrit: svi̱dhmā yad va̱nadhi̍tir apa̱syāt sūro̍ adhva̱re pari̱ rodha̍nā̱ goḥ | yad dha̍ pra̱bhāsi̱ kṛtvyā̱m̐ anu̱ dyūn ana̍rviśe pa̱śviṣe̍ tu̱rāya̍ ||
english: When the forest-axe, kindled by its own fuel, sees the Sun at the sacrifice surrounded by the enclosures of the cow; when you shine through the days along the ritual paths — for the swift one who knows no weariness, who seeks cattle.

sanskrit: a̱ṣṭā ma̱ho di̱va ādo̱ harī̍ i̱ha dyu̍mnā̱sāha̍m a̱bhi yo̍dhā̱na utsa̍m | hari̱ṁ yat te̍ ma̱ndina̱ṁ du̱kṣan vṛ̱dhe gora̍bhasa̱m adri̍bhir vā̱tāpya̍m ||
english: He smote the great heaven, bringing hither the two tawny steeds — glorious, conquering, fighting toward the spring. When they pressed out for your growth the tawny exhilarating one — swift as the wind, the one to be pressed on stones, the udder of cattle.

sanskrit: tvam ā̍ya̱sam prati̍ vartayo̱ gor di̱vo aśmā̍na̱m upa̍nīta̱m ṛbhvā̍ | kutsā̍ya̱ yatra̍ puruhūta va̱nvañ chuṣṇa̍m ana̱ntaiḥ pa̍ri̱yāsi̍ va̱dhaiḥ ||
english: You turned back the iron stone of heaven brought close — O skilful one — belonging to the cow; where, O much-invoked Indra, conquering for Kutsa, you encircle Śuṣṇa with boundless deadly blows.

sanskrit: pu̱rā yat sūra̱s tama̍so̱ apī̍te̱s tam a̍drivaḥ phali̱gaṁ he̱tim a̍sya | śuṣṇa̍sya ci̱t pari̍hita̱ṁ yad ojo̍ di̱vas pari̱ sugra̍thita̱ṁ tad āda̍ḥ ||
english: Before the Sun emerged from the darkness — O stone-wielder — you seized his cleft weapon. Even the might of Śuṣṇa that was set around him, firmly knotted from heaven — that you took away.

sanskrit: anu̍ tvā ma̱hī pāja̍sī aca̱kre dyāvā̱kṣāmā̍ madatām indra̱ karma̍n | tvaṁ vṛ̱tram ā̱śayā̍naṁ si̱rāsu̍ ma̱ho vajre̍ṇa siṣvapo va̱rāhu̍m ||
english: The two great expanses, Heaven and Earth, rejoiced following your deed, O Indra — let them exult. You slew with the great thunderbolt Vṛtra lying across the streams, the boar.

sanskrit: tvam i̍ndra̱ naryo̱ yām̐ avo̱ nṝn tiṣṭhā̱ vāta̍sya su̱yujo̱ vahi̍ṣṭhān | yaṁ te̍ kā̱vya u̱śanā̍ ma̱ndina̱ṁ dād vṛ̍tra̱haṇa̱m pārya̍ṁ tatakṣa̱ vajra̍m ||
english: O Indra, heroic one — the men you favored, stand with the best-harnessed team of the wind. The exhilarating, Vṛtra-slaying thunderbolt for crossing over which the wise Uśanā Kāvya gave you — he fashioned it.

sanskrit: a̱smai ba̱lāya̍ ka̱vayo̱ giro̱ arkā̍ṁ ṛ̱bhava̍ḥ svā̱dhiyaś cā̍karanta | ye vā̱jino̍ ya̱jñiya̍sya śra̱vāṁsy ā̱ sūrya̍sya sa̱rasva̍tī̱ jyoti̍ḥ ||
english: For this his might the seers, the Ṛbhus of good insight, fashioned their hymns and songs — those who illumine the glories of the prize-winning, the sacrificial — and Sarasvatī, the light of the Sun.

sanskrit: u̱ta sma̱ tasya̱ prekṣa̍māṇā avā̱cyo 'va̱ syasya̍ pitaro na ya̱jñe | ṛ̱bhu sca̍kra̱ upa̍ stuṣe pura̱mdhim a̱smā u̱ viśvā̍ bhuvanāni tāruḥ ||
english: And indeed gazing at that one's act — the fathers at the sacrifice looked below like those of the lower one. I praise Ṛbhu and Cakra for their insight; may all beings cross over for his sake.

sanskrit: ā̱śāpā̍lam ṛ̱ghāva̍ṇaṁ vṛ̱dha indrā̍ya śū̱ṣam ma̱ndina̍ṁ su̱tāya̍ | de̱vīr āpa̱ḥ pari̱ bādha̍nta dro̱ṇyai̱nāṁ rādha̍ḥ soma̱sya vi̱datha̍ eva mahyam ||
english: The guardian of the quarters, the roaring one who gives strength — an exhilarating shout for Indra at the pressed Soma. The divine waters press around the trough; grant me such a boon of Soma in the assembly.

sanskrit: pra śa̍rdha̱ māru̍taṁ su̱me kā̍nā vi̱vasvat̍ pṛ̱cchāmi̍ ro̱daṣī̍ | ke vā̍ ṛ̱tasya̱ saccha̍nto mi̱tho dru̱haṁ na ma̍nvaite ||
english: I ask the joyful host of the Maruts, in their goodness, together with Vivasvat — Heaven and Earth: who are they who, following Ṛta in common, do not take account of mutual treachery?

sanskrit: ā ta̍k ka̱vinā̍ ci̱d ā ṛ̍ta̱spṛśā̍ maha̱ā ṛ̍ta̱spṛśā̍ | ā varuṇa̱ṁ bṛha̱d ā mi̱traṁ va̍vo̱ḍhve 'nu̍ṣak sva̱rvidaṁ sva̍rvidam ||
english: Hither then, O Kavis, hither — O ye who touch Ṛta, great ones who touch Ṛta — hither Varuṇa, greatly; hither Mitra, the finder of heaven, the finder of heaven — you have borne them continuously.

sanskrit: kū̱ṭaṁ ca̍ rā̱ya ā bha̍ra da̱kṣiṇā̍to vi̱śāṁ pate̍ | i̱to vā̱ sādhvi̍t tvā vacanty āvṛ̱tā i̱to vā̍ sādhv it tvā va̱cana̱ty āvṛ̍tā ||
english: Bring a bull's worth of riches from the south, O lord of the clans. Either from here may they rightly speak to you as you return, or from here may they rightly speak to you as you turn back.

sanskrit: ye ca̍ ni̱tyāso̱ adhi̍ bā̱hv ojā̍ṁsy āvṛ̱tā maha̍tāṁ | ta̱ān nū na̍ indra su̱ta ā ci̍ketati ciketatu ||
english: Those who are the constant ones dwelling in the mighty powers of the arm — may Indra now perceive them at the pressed Soma; may he take heed of them.

sanskrit: vi̱yo no̱ adri̍r abhi̱ṣāḷ va̍vṛtya̱d vajra̍hasto maha̍tā va̱dhena̍ | i̱ṣire̍ vā̱yur uta̍ pūṣa̱ṇā vā̍ṁ yā vā̱ṁ dhenū̱ aś vinā̍ pī̱papā̍tha ||
english: May the stone-armed one thrust aside our adversarial boulder with his great weapon, thunderbolt in hand. Active Vāyu too — and Pūṣan — and the milch-cows of you two, O Aśvins, which have given milk to you.

sanskrit: ū̱rjaṁ no̍ dhehi dvi̱padī̱ catu̍ṣpade̱ anu̍ vrataṁ mīḷhu̱ṣo na̍ḥ saśca̱tī | divā̍ na̱ktaṁ ś uri̍ṣā ya̱tiṣva̍ so̱masya̍ rā̱yasya̍ pa̱rṇino̍ vasvā ||
english: Grant us vigor for our two-footed and four-footed creatures, following the ordinance of the bountiful one attending us. Both by day and night, O liberal one, strive — with the wealth of Soma's riches, with the full abundance.

sanskrit: ā no̍ bhe̱jo dha̍rmaṇā pū̱ṣaṇo̍ gā̱t pu̱rā vi̱śo a̍bhiyujaḥ kṛ̱ṇvata̍ḥ | ya̱kṣi ta̱d ṛta̍m uta̍ vai bhag u̱rau su̱yujo̱ viśva̍ḥ puruhūta dehi naḥ ||
english: May Pūṣan by his natural law come to our share before the clans make assault. Worship Ṛta, and also grant a wide share; O much-invoked one, bestow upon us all that is well yoked.

sanskrit: ā ta̍ indra̱ mahā̱m̐ asi̍ ma̱hi sto̍travāhā̱ ā ya̍hi | i̱ndro ya̍rhy uta̱ prekṣ ā̍te vi̱śvā sā̍dhā̱ram a̍bhivṛtya̱ sūryo̍ na rocase divi ||
english: Come here, O Indra — you are great; great are those who carry praises; come. When Indra looks around, encompassing all common supports, he shines in heaven like the Sun.

sanskrit: pra su̍ṣṭutim arca̱ta yo̍ mātu̱laḥ sa̍pta̱ śyāvī̍bhiḥ | sa̍pta vo̍ ratha̱ā hari̱ta ā ja̍gmuḥ śa̱kvarī̍ṣu ha̱ṁsā iva̍ ||
english: Sing forth the hymn of praise to him who is the maternal uncle — with seven dark-bay mares; seven green chariots have come to you, like swans in the skilled songs.

sanskrit: yad indra̱ rādha̍ḥ su̱ta āma̍ndasya̱ tad dha̍ te̱ rādha̍ḥ | śrīṇā̱ti yo no̍ hara̱sy an̍tarā̱ deva̍ ū̱tī ta̍t te mahimānam a̱rcāma̍ ||
english: Whatever boon belongs to you, O Indra, at the pressed Soma — of that exhilarating one — verily that is your boon. He who embellishes us, drawing us within his divine aid — that greatness of yours we shall praise.

sanskrit: ā ya̱ntu mitro̍ varu̱ṇo na̍ḥ su̱tāvāṁ ā̱rdrā va̱śaṁ ka̍ś cid asmā̱kam arva̍t | ā dhenu̱r ā go̍ dhena̱v ā no̍ vo̱ṣṭā mahā̍ntā vardhayantāṁ va̱yam ||
english: May Mitra and Varuṇa come to us who have pressed Soma; let someone whose horse is swift come to our wish while it is moist. May a milch-cow come, may cattle come, may our transport come — may those two great ones increase us.

sanskrit: ā no̍ mitra mahi̱ṣaṁ gṛ̍ṇīhi̱ ā va̍ruṇa̱ mahin̍ā ya̱jñiyā̍so | ā no̍ de̱vo bṛha̍spati̱r ṛbhi̍ṣṭhāḥ pu̱rāṁdhi̱r ā va̱rca̍ā śaśvad āgāt ||
english: Sing to us the great one, O Mitra; O Varuṇa, the worthy of sacrifice in your greatness; may the god Bṛhaspati, he who reaches the highest, Puraṁdhi, come always bringing us brilliance.

sanskrit: a̱nu dyu̱matyā̍ raghuyā̱ dhiya̍ā ya̱nti de̱vāso̱ apī̍tyā | a̱smā u̍ te na̱mas triḥ sap̍ta yā̱ntyā ya̍nti̱ namo̱bhi yo na̍maḥ ||
english: Following a luminous, swift thought, the gods come along the path of approach. Thrice seven — three times seven — do they go to him with homage; homage to him who is revered with homage.

sanskrit: ṛ̱tā̱vānā̍v ṛ̱tayu̍jā su̱dutā̍ ra̱thīna̱taro̍ dha̱ruṇa̱m ā vṛ̍ṇāthe | dhā̱raya̍nmānā ā̱ṣāḍhe̍ su̱tāyā̱ vyoma̍n mitra̱ā prā̍vo māvantu naḥ ||
english: Possessors of Ṛta, yoked with Ṛta, well-milked, surpassing charioteers — you two occupy the foundation. Upholding the invincible one at the pressed Soma, O Mitras in the expanse of sky — favor us and bless us.

sanskrit: pra ya̍d di̱vasya̍ va̱ruṇo̍ mi̱trasya̱ ā rādha̍so̱ vari̍māṇam eti̱ rājan̍ | asmā̱kaṁ bodhi̍ pitaraṁ na̱ ū̱tī dyu̱mnaṁ vayana̱ṁ ci̍kituṣe hava̱māha̍ ||
english: When Varuṇa proceeds to the breadth of the wealth of Mitra and of heaven, O king — be as a father to us with your aid; we call upon the inspired one for glory and sustenance.

sanskrit: u̱ṣā u̍ nu̱ bhāti̍ sū̱nṛtā̍ ca sā de̱vī cu̍cot ca̱ su̱pratiṁ ca dā̍ti | ye̱ṣām vaha̍t su̱matiṁ śyā̍vagre̍ṣu ratho̍ devā̱nāṁ pra̍tidhānam u̱ṣaḥ ||
english: Dawn indeed now shines; the goddess is truthful and bestows good guidance. For those whose chariot she carries — with dark bays at the front — Dawn is the countersign of the gods with their benevolence.

sanskrit: pu̱ra eti̱ pratyuṣa̱ḥ pra ti̍ṣṭhate̱ dyo vy a̍kta̱ḥ prati̍ ity u̱ṣāsam | a̱yāsya̍sya bha̱drā śravo̍ vayo̱ rādho̍ aheva̱ pra ti̍ranty a̱heva̍ ||
english: She goes before, Dawn goes forth; daylight has become apparent, greeting the Dawn. The good glory, strength, and bounty of Āyāsya extend forward day by day, as it were — extending day by day.

sanskrit: pra̱tnā me̍dhā na̱vaṁ śa̍ṁsa yā śa̱śvad u̍ṣo vā̱ryaṁ bhavā̍ti | gā̱vo na vrajaṁ yūtha̍śa upā̱va̱ ābhā̍ti jyotiṣā viśvam ā̱bhaḥ ||
english: Ancient wisdom proclaims the new: what is ever desirable, O Uṣas, shall come to be. Like cows going in herds to the pen, she illumines all with her light — shining upon all as she comes near.

sanskrit: u̱cchiṣṭā̱ ghṛta̍m upa̱ yanti̍ vajriṇam ṛ̱tasya̍ panthā̱m anu̱ yanti̍ sā̱dhava̍ḥ | a̱she sa̍ptasya̱ dvipa̱das tu̍ra̱ṇyava̍ḥ samu̱drasya̍ dhānā̱ḥ pari̍ yanti bhu̱vana̍m ||
english: The sacrificial leavings go up to the thunderbolt-wielder with ghee; the righteous ones follow the path of Ṛta. The swift ones, the portions of the seven-wheeled, two-footed one, travel around the world like the seeds of the ocean.

sanskrit: pra sā̍ ta̍ uṣaḥ sūnṛ̱tā̍ jagad dhuve̱ pra su śā̍sīra̱ ajaramā va̍han | e̱nā ratho̱ divi̍ṣat sūnṛ̱tāva̍riśyā̱n paṭhaḥ su̍kṛ̱tasya̱ no de̱vi gā̍nt ||
english: O Uṣas, this truthful one calls forth the living world for you; sing praises; carry onward the undecaying one. By these means may the chariot dwelling in heaven — truthful and imperishable — follow the path of our right deeds, O goddess.

sanskrit: pra bo̍dhaya̱ pitaraṁ yā̍ñ ca mī̱ḷha uṣo̍ yāhy u̱ṣasā̱m e̍hī̱ śre̍ṣṭhā | ni̱śeva̍ sū̱nṛtā̍ yāty u̱ṣṭrī ci̱tra̍ jā̱yate̱ tamasā̍ vi̱yuktā̍ ||
english: O Uṣas, awaken the father who is bountiful; come, come as the best of dawns. The truthful she-camel goes like night; the brilliant one is born, freed from darkness.

sanskrit: āyu̱r yacchantī̍ cara̱ṇe̱ vyakta̱ bha̱drā su̱bhagā̱ sumanā̍ u̱ṣā agā̍t | vi tasya̍ ketū̱m̐ a̱ṇvate̍ na viṣṭha̱ṁ jāni̱ patiṁ na̍ bhi̱yaḥ su̍vāsāḥ ||
english: Granting long life at her approach, made visible — auspicious, fortunate, well-disposed — Uṣas has come. She unfurls his banner without obstruction, like a well-dressed wife who does not fear her husband.

sanskrit: vy u̍ṣṭhāḥ sū̱nṛtā̍ ga̱vāṁ gṛbhī̍tri̱ śuca̱ stomo̍ bha̱vatu̱ reko̱ asy āḥ | pra ya̍t kā̱maṁ na ra̍ṇayad vi̱bhindu̱r māna̱ṁ vaṣṭi̱ sa te̍ satya̱vasū̍rvā ||
english: You have shone, O truthful one — you who seize the cows; may the clear hymn become the treasure of her. For he who, when she scatters her gifts, does not rejoice in your wish — the wise one who desires proper measure shall find you wealthy in true goods.

sanskrit: kiyā̱ty ā ya̍t sā̱m̐ dṛśa̍ uṣā̱ māṁ ci̱d ānaṁ śu̱cim ā̍raṇyam | kṣa̱peṇa̍ rātrī̱ pari̱ ṣasva̍jāne̱ jyotiṣ kṛ̱ṇvan sā̱dhum āja̍t ||
english: How long until that Dawn shall be seen from near at hand — even this clear, shining, distant one? Night has embraced herself with the night, making light, driving the righteous onward.

sanskrit: u̱ṣas tve̍ṣā vy̱uccha̱nty ā va̍suṁ jā̱yantī prata̍raṇī na̱va dyauḥ | ya̱d dha̍ pra̱bhāti̱ rājā̍nā pa̱rasparaṁ su̱vīraṁ yaccha̍taṁ go̱mato̍ no ṛ̱dhak ||
english: O Uṣas, shining brilliantly — the wealth-bearing, the newly-born, the new day that carries one onward. When you both kings shall shine together upon each other, grant us good heroes and cattle separately.

sanskrit: u̱ṣo ye te pra̍ya̱sā̍ sū̱nṛtā̍vat pra̱ṇetā̍raḥ kṛ̱ṇvate̍ āta̱re yo̍ | yā̱māṁ dhanvā̱ sānu̍ṣu sā̱dhur āja̱n me̍dhā̱sātā̱v ṛta̍yanta dhi̱rā ye ||
english: O Uṣas, those who, with your gifts, truthful and leading, make crossings — may the straight one drive along the plains and ridges; may those who are wise be triumphant in the acquisition of wisdom according to Ṛta.

sanskrit: ye te u̍ṣaḥ su̱matī̍n ā̱vṛṇā̍te̱ 'śvo na vāja̍m sa̱nitu̱ṁ nu̍ śaktam | dhī̱mānte̍ teṣu pra̱ṇeti̱ spṛhā̍ya̱ṁ dhiyaṁ te̍ de̱vyā̍ī yuvam ||
english: Those who, O Uṣas, grasp your benevolence — like a horse capable now of winning the prize — may their wise one lead and may the longing for that thought be joined with you, O divine Dawn.

sanskrit: śuci̱ṣ ṭvā a̍dya̱ su̱mnayā̍ śuci̱ṣṭamo̍ apā̱vaḥ pitha̱ viśpa̍tiḥ | a̱gnir de̱vāḿ a̱bhī śa̍su̱ṣe ma̍hate̱ vāja̍sātaye ||
english: The most brilliant one, Agni the lord of the clan, has now purified you the brilliant one in grace toward good intent. Agni has shouted toward the gods for the great winning of the prize.

sanskrit: a̱dṛṣṭā ya̍nty aru̱ṇā sva̍sārō̱ dīrgha̍sya dhā̱tā tama̍saḥ parā̱ke | di̱vī̱yasā̍māyo̱kṣaṇī̱ sapta̍ yo̱niṁ śi̱kṣan mahe̍ pra̱yato̱ babhū̍va ||
english: The ruddy sisters come unseen from afar, dispersing long darkness in the distance. The one who yokes the seven in heaven, devoted to their source — bestowing upon the great one, he has become readied.

sanskrit: vi̱bhāva̍rī̱r ūrja̍yantī bhavanti prā̱cī ā̱ y uchati̍ jyotiṣā sa̱rdhatī̍ | u̱ṣā itī̍ samā̱nā bha̍vanty u̱ṣā rā̱ya āsna̍te nara̍s te ||
english: They who spread light, who give strength — they are coming; the eastern one dawns, pressing forward with radiance. Dawn upon dawn they become the same; at Dawn men reach for riches — those are her men.

sanskrit: prati̱ ced bhī̍mā aruṣī̱ juhu̱rād a̍ks̱anti pādā̍ mahi̱ṣaṁ na̱ dundhu̍bham | su̱samṛ̍ddham u̱ṣasaṁ pra bra̍vmā na̱ tasya̍ de̱vīm ava̍nīm mahi̱tvā ||
english: Against her the fearful ruddy one has indeed rushed, striking the buffalo like a drum with her feet. Let us proclaim Dawn fully glorious — a goddess of great might, not to be surpassed.

sanskrit: e̱tā agan̍ dha̱ruṇam̐ ṛ̱tasya̍ pa̱nthaṁ devā̍nā̱m anu̱ yat sada̍smā | ta̱nu̱tyajā̱ aruṣī̍r a̱kṣann e̱tā gāvo̱ na ta̍vare̱ hvi̱yante̍ ||
english: These Dawn-goddesses have come to the foundation of Ṛta, following the path that belongs to the gods' seat. The ruddy ones have shone, shedding their bodies — these are called forth like cows to their resting-place.

sanskrit: ā gā a̱smā airu̍ṣīr vi̱śva a̍ntar yo̱nau jā̱yante̍ bhuvanā̱nā a̍sam | ā mā̍rjayanty a̱bhi rādha̍yantī̱r uṣā̍ āpo̱ na mahī̍ pu̱rī̍ṣe ||
english: The ruddy ones drive the cows here for him — within the womb all beings are born together. Polishing and bestowing wealth, Dawn comes like the great waters to the nourishment of the land.

sanskrit: u̱ṣo yana̍ntī̱m apa̱ ye ra̍ma̱dhvaṁ ye cā̍sya̱ vājaṁ su̱bhago̍ vivā̱sa | e̱ṣā su̱manā̱ ā vya̍cchad u̱ṣā rādha̍ḥ sa̱vaṁ no̱ manu̍ṣe̱ dayi̍ṣṭhe ||
english: O Dawn, you who go — rest away from those who slumber, and those who, fortunate, seek your bounty. This benevolent Dawn has dawned wide; she is most generous with bounty to human Manu, with her generous gift to us.

sanskrit: u̱ṣā a̍sya̱ varā̍gam āvar a̱sminn ā̱ṣya pari̍bādhe̱ dyu̍manā̱yadum̍ | a̱ti̱hva̍ranti̱ ṣu vy u̍ṣa̱ś ca̱ ri̍to mahā̱ṁ si̱ndhu̱r arṇa̍vān iva̱ pra ta̍rsan ||
english: Dawn has revealed this choice of his, radiant in its restraint, full of brilliance. The Dawns move swiftly across and beyond — the great Sindhu flooding, crossing like the oceans.

sanskrit: u̱ṣo rādha̍ḥ su̱tuk so̍mapī̱thāya̍ yā de̱vī de̱vāya̍ pra̱ṣṭhavā̱hā | dhā̱yi̍ sapta̱ śrave̍ṇo̱ māta̍rā de̱vī āpa̱d rādha̍ḥ sūnu̱rthe̱ anu̍ ||
english: O Uṣas, bring wealth quickly for the Soma-drinking — you who are the divine one who carries the divine in front. The mother goddess set in seven rays of renown; the divine one reached the wealth in pursuit of the son's prosperity.

sanskrit: ā ya̍t kṣa̱yam parame̱ṣṭhyaṁ nu ra̍nta̱ ṛtasya̍ panthā̱ṁ nar a̍nusācat | u̱ṣo rādha̍ḥ su̱vīryaṁ rā̱yas po̍ṣam a̱smabhya̱ṁ viśva̱m ā bha̍ra ||
english: When they rejoice now at the highest abode, man follows the path of Ṛta. O Uṣas, bring to us all wealth — good heroism, the increase of riches.

sanskrit: u̱ṣo yā̍hi pa̱tha̱m̐ rātī̍ bhago̱ ma̱dam a̍ṅgirasāṁ go̱mat sūktā̍vad asmān | īyur̍ anu̱ pūrve̍ vyuṣṭiṣu̱ tvayi̱ rāyo̱ vasa̱v ā bha̍ra ca rā̱ya āvṛ̍tā ||
english: O Uṣas, come along the path — the share, the exhilaration of the Aṅgirasas, cattle-rich, with good hymns for us. The earlier ones followed at your dawnings; O wealth-bearing one, bring riches and return with riches.

sanskrit: bha̱drā a̍śvā hari̱ta u̱cchava̍cā̱ yā̱bhi su̱tṛpā̍ḥ sū̱ryasya̱ patnī̍ | uru̱m anu̍ vrata̱m ā bha̍ra̱nty u̱ṣo rādha̍ḥ suṣṭu̱tir na̱ māmā̍ ||
english: The auspicious tawny-green horses of varying kinds, by which the wife of the Sun is well-nourished — O Uṣas, driving along the broad ordinance, bring us wealth; let no praise of ours be fruitless.

sanskrit: rāyo̱ vasu̍ de̱vī de̍vatamā̱ na̱ā māyā̍bhiḥ sumana̱syamā̍nā | a̱sminn a̱hann̐ u̱ṣasi̱ pra bo̍dhā̱ asminn a̍hann āsu̱taye̍ jaritṛbhyaḥ ||
english: O divine goddess, most divine of the wealthy and goods — with your arts, well-disposed toward us — awaken at this dawn today; awaken on this day for the pressing, for the praisers.

sanskrit: a̱sme dhā̱ rāyo̱ vibha̍vaṁ pu̱rurūpa̱m id u̍ṣaḥ pra̱jāvad a̱śvāva̍d u | ta̱nā va̱yo dha̍rmaṇā̱ pūya̍mānaḥ ka̱vir de̱vaḥ pra̍ti̱māna̍ṁ puru̱ṣṭu ||
english: O Uṣas, grant to us wealth of wide spread in many forms — with offspring, with horses. May the divine seer, being purified along the extension of his life by the law, praise what is set as the measure, greatly lauded.

sanskrit: pra me̍ pu̱rutama̍sya̱ rave̱ su śa̍ṁsa ku̱vit sa ta̍ indra̱ mahi̱ṣo ma̍na̱svī | ya e̍naṁ yu̱dhā ya̍ti̱ varsi̍ṣṭha̱ṁ tasmā̍ u̱ gāṁ gavya̍m ava̱sā dā̍ ||
english: Proclaim for me, the very pious one, a good praise — is he truly the great, noble one, O Indra? He who goes to war with the highest one — to him grant a cow, yield the cattle-wealth with protection.

sanskrit: ya ī̍m a̱nu prā̍va̱t sa id u̍ grā̱maṁ vajeṣu̍ śa̱kra ta̱va pa̍r pu̱raṁ dhiḥ | ni̱ṣka̍ṁ yaś ci̱ttiṁ na̍r a̱pā ga̱meyā̍d rā̱ye ga̱māma̍ su̱tīrṇā̍ gṛ̱ṇan ||
english: He who has helped him along — surely he, O Śakra, is insight in the village during the prize-fights of your fortress. May the one who would set aside golden ornament and wisdom for any man — let us, praising, go to riches, well-crossed.

sanskrit: uta̍ sya ka̱kṣīva̍ta̱ś ca darśa̱ idaṁ ra̱yiṁ ju̱juṣe̍ pī̱va̱ id e̍naḥ | sa hi nā̱thitā̍m ava̱sā ya̍ti̱ṣṭha pra ya̍t ka̱ṇvāya̱ sumatiṁ śa̱śā̍stha ||
english: Moreover, the sight of Kakṣīvat — he has enjoyed the plump wealth, the sin is upon him. For he who stands best in aid goes toward those who call for help, as you have declared good thought to Kaṇva.

sanskrit: u̱ta bra̍hmaṇa̱ u̱ta rā̍janyas ta̱d upa̱ śrutaṁ ā̍śvan vā̱jy āsa̍d | ya ī̍ śu̱śrāva̍ śṛṇavad ya̱jiṣṭha̱ḥ stave̍ta vṛtra̱hā de̱vaḥ śaśvat̍ ||
english: Both the brahmin and the rājanya hear this — the prize-winning stallion shall be at hand. He who has heard shall hear; the most sacrifice-worthy one — may the god, the Vṛtra-slayer, be praised constantly.

sanskrit: yo dvā̱dasa̍ mā̱sān ma̱ṇḍalā̍d a̱pety upa̱ yo jana̍s tava sumna̱yur me̍ | ta̱smā u̱ gāṁ dā da̱śa go̍ṣu̱bhi yū̍tha̱ṁ śata̍mūrdhānaṁ rā̱yas po̱ṣaṁ su̍vi̱tam ||
english: He who goes away from the circle for twelve months — he is the one graciously devoted to you, O people of mine. To him grant a cow from among ten cows — a herd with a hundred leaders — and the prosperity of riches, a good path.

sanskrit: ga̱viṣṭhirā̍ya yo̱ dade̱ hi̱raya̍m pa̱ñca śa̍tā gavi̱ṣṭhira̍sya̱ gobhi̍ḥ | kṛ̱ṣṇasy a̱dbhuta̱ṁ mahi̍maṇaṁ vociḥ ku̱vit sa no̱ goma̱d aśvā̍vad āsāt ||
english: He who gave gold to Gaviṣṭhira, five hundreds — with the cattle of Gaviṣṭhira — you have spoken the wondrous greatness of Kṛṣṇa; shall that one now be for us with cattle and horses?

sanskrit: de̱vānā̍ṁ śa̱rdham u̱ pa̍ri̱ ṣad a̱smai ra̱yim nā̍ma̱ bha̍ja ka̱lyāṇa̱ṁ sūri̍ḥ | a̱sminn a̍dya bha̱gavad ya̍vasya ma̱hate vā̍jabha̱ño ra̱yiṁ dha̍ ||
english: May the patron sit around this one with the host of the gods; let the rich one share him a name of beautiful riches. May he in whom today there is the share of this grass — the great prize-winner — place wealth here.

sanskrit: ā ghā̱ ta ya̍nti di̱vasaḥ pari̍ ye̱to 'bhi rāṣṭrā̍ṇi su̱kṛtā̍ṁ viśanti | vi̍śvā̱yur de̱vo a̍ditir yajā̱tā ā tā va̍yaṁ śa̱rdha u̱s to ya̍yāma ||
english: Those of good deeds indeed come from the heavens, going around, entering the kingdoms. The all-living god Aditi is worthy of sacrifice — we have yoked ourselves to their host for praise.

sanskrit: i̱dam u̍ tyad u̱ktham pa̱rāya̱ṇāya̍ vi̱śve de̱vā a̱nu śyā̍vagre̱ṣā | pra śuddha̱ṁ ta̱ indu̍m vicakṣa̱ṇāya̍ pī̱tvā a̍dha̱ reḥ su̍hava̱sya ki̱ttaṁ pī̱tvā ||
english: This is that hymn for the one going beyond — all the gods follow with dark bays in front. The pure Indu goes forth to the discerning one; having drunk, then understand what is destined for the good-invoked one — having drunk.

sanskrit: pūrve̍bhir ṛ̱ṣibhir i̍ndra̱ nūna̍m upa̱stuta̍ḥ pu̱ruhū̱ ta ya̍jñaiḥ | nū naṁ tu̍ta̱ indra̍ maho̱ ṣu ṇo̍ 'vāḥ pu̱ro ye̍ the diśā bhūr ibhā̱m no̍ bhi vī̱raṁ ||
english: O Indra, much-invoked one — praised now by the ancient seers with sacrifices; now, too, O Indra, help us greatly; be in front as a direction of your wealth; be for us as heroes.

sanskrit: ā no̱ viśvā̍su ha̱vya eti̍ sū̱rī aśveṣu̍ hi̱raṇye̱ṣu go̍ṣu | mā no̍ ra̱kṣobhi̱r hva̍ra̱ sva̱sto di̱vo va̍riṣṭhād adhivocatā naḥ ||
english: May the patron come to us with all invocations — with horses, with gold, with cattle. Let not the demons harm us in well-being; speak for us from the height of heaven.

sanskrit: ka̱vi kavy̍a kavi̱tve asti̍ varṇe̱ yo vā̱ ṛtasya̍ bṛha̱t śra̍vasi | te a̱gnī ā̍ bhara ca̱ te ma̍he̱ no vi̱tn sapta̍ ni̱ṣkatā̍ a̱rcāmi̍ ||
english: A poet among poets, he is poetic in his nature — he who is in the great glory of Ṛta. Bring those fires to us for our greatness; I sing the seven necklace-wearers.

sanskrit: ro̱maharge̱ṇa̱ rohi̍ta̱ ā va̱rthanta̍ṁ vā̱jino̍ maruto na̱ tannā̍ | i̱dam a̱haṁ su̍dā̱nāv a̱ṅgi̍rase pa̱ñca̱ viṁśa̍tim vatsa̱r ā ga̍m ||
english: With a rosy-hair garland, ruddy steeds growing high — Maruts with prize-winning streaks on their bodies. I, coming from among the Aṅgirasas, have come to the generous giver for twenty-five years.

sanskrit: a̱gnī̱dhraṁ ca̍ su̱dāyo̍ a̱nti pa̍śyeyuḥ śata̱taṁ hima̍ḥ | asmā̍kāso magha̱vantas tarantu̍ sam ī̱nā vā̍ji̱nā e̍ta śata̱ṁ ma̍haḥ ||
english: May they who are generous see the fire-priest nearby for a hundred winters. May our wealthy ones cross over; come together, O prize-winning ones, to the hundred greatnesses.

sanskrit: śu̱ciḥ pāva̍kaḥ su̱bṛhac chu̱cir yo̍nau̱ śuciṁ kṣāma̱ śucir va̍sānaḥ | śu̱cibhir nā̍māni̱ yajato̍ yajā̱tāgniṁ stome̍bhi̱r div ya̍ u̱ no gṛṇāmaḥ ||
english: Pure, purifying, very bright, pure in the womb, pure on the earth, clothed in purity — with pure names, the worshipful one worthy of sacrifice — we praise divine Agni with hymns of praise.

sanskrit: yo de̍va̱yū anu̍ sa̱ptan na̍ ra̱tmī su̱jāta̱ḥ śiśu̱r nā dyuta̍d arci̱ṣā | vi ya̱d etu̍r ni̱ṣ ṭhure̍bhi̱ḥ śuci̍tvā devā̱n ā su̍di̱te bha̍jad vā̱yave̍ ||
english: He who, delighting in the gods, blazes following the seven, well-born like a shining child with flame — when the pure one went out and separated from the hard ones, may he share the gods with Vāyu at the good kindling.

sanskrit: upa̱ tmana̍ḥ pa̱sur eka̱ṁ na ta̍kṣat sa̱ ha yo̱nāv a̍su̱rās ta̍tisthe̱ | anā̍rtiṁ suṣ̱ṭavā̍jaṁ na vā̱jasā̍tāv a̱gniṁ ho̍tā̱raṁ ā̱ va̍ ca̍ stā 'gniṁ ||
english: One has fashioned it by his own self, like a single beast; the powerful one stands established in the womb. In the prize-contest, like one free of harm and bearing good prizes — invoke Agni as the calling priest, Agni.

sanskrit: taṁ tve̍ a̱gne ma̱nthi̍na̱ indra̍vantaṁ de̱vāso̍ a̱gniṁ no̱ hotra̍yā gṛ̱ṇanti̍ | a̱dhva̱rā no̍ ya̱jñā a̍gniṁ samu̱draṁ so̍ma̱pā a̍ bha̱jantā̍m uta̱ pākā̍ḥ ||
english: O Agni, the gods praise you, possessing Indra among the churning sticks, as Agni, for our calling-sacrifice. May our sacrifices at the ritual — with Agni as their ocean, Soma-drinking ones — have a share, and also the simple ones.

sanskrit: saṁ jā̍yate stau̱mi ya̱sya kra̍tve yā̱n indra̍ ī̍ṣe pa̱ramā̍sam a̱gniḥ | a̱tur a̍gne pu̱ruṣa̱s tvam id dha̱ tvaṁ su̍kṣi̱tir de̱va a̍si ||
english: At whose will he is born together — I praise him — the Agni of highest essence whom Indra rules. O Agni, you are the indefatigable person; you indeed are the divine good dwelling-place.

sanskrit: tvaṁ dā̍tā pratha̱mo rā̍yi̱ṣaṣ ṭhā̱ aśva̍dā bhe̱jir atha̍ sā no yā̱hi | svā̱nā iva̍ su̱ktaṁ ca̱rathā̍ya ma̱nda ye vi̱bhrāja̍nte̱ vīdha̍vo na yo̱ṣā ||
english: You are the first giver of wealth in the foremost place — horse-giving, bestowing shares; come then to us. You delight well in good hymns for traversal, like chanting ones — you who shine bright like wealthy widows.

sanskrit: e̱ṣa te̍ yonir ṛ̱tviyaḥ pa̱rī ṣu̱ namo̍bhi̱r āsiṣā̍ si̱ñcantā̍m | yajā̍te̱ ye vai na̍mo̱bhi indrā̍gni su̱ṣṭutī̍bhi̱r ā vi̍vāsate ||
english: This is your seasonal womb — may they anoint it all around with homage and blessings. Those who are worthy of sacrifice, who indeed seek to gain Indra and Agni with homage and good praises.

sanskrit: yo a̍dha̱ pṛthu̍ṣ ṭa̱va bṛha̱d anu̍ bṛ̱hac chu̱krasyā̱rciḥ pra bha̍va̱ti pra no̍ astu | supe̱śā vi̍śva̱vāra̱ ā ni̍ya̱ccha te̍ su̱menā̍maḥ sudhyo sa pu̱rī̍ṣyaḥ ||
english: He whose great flame of the brilliant one grows downward broadly and greatly extends beyond — let it be forth for us. O beautiful one of all treasures, hold back for yourself what is well-disposed; he is of good mind, of good insight, worthy of nourishment.

sanskrit: a̱gnir hotā̍ ni̱ṣad ṛ̱taṁ yajā̍te̱ viśve̍ de̱vā a̱nu̍ mādan u̍ | vi̱śpati̍r vṛ̱dho a̱gni ra̱thīr nṝn rā̱yaspo̍ṣaṁ ya̱jama̍nāya̱ dhehi̱ hotā̍ ||
english: Agni as the calling priest has sat down; Ṛta is sacrificed; all the gods rejoice following. Agni, the lord of the clan who delights heroic men — as the calling priest, place the prosperity of wealth for the sacrificer.

sanskrit: imam u tyam a̍gnim i̱dhmo̍ ānu̱dīdhar̍ṣan marte̱ṣu vi̍ceti̱ ma̍nā̱ naḥ | kave̱ pratvā̍n ma̱hiṣo̱ yad a̱rhann a̱hnā vā̍ ya̱jñaṁ me̍ dha̱sātā̍vā ||
english: This fire — the kindling has roused it; our mind shines knowingly among mortals. O seer, when the great bull is worthy by its power — either by day in the sacrifice or in the acquiring of wisdom.

sanskrit: e̱tā na̍ indra̱ śava̍sā pu̱rū̍ṇy ā̱ ta vā̍ mahi̱tva̍ṁ śa̱kra pra̍ vo̱cauḥ | ye te̱ manu̍ṣvat sa̱ṁsi̍dhante̱ narā̍ asmā̱kaṁ bodhi̱ śloka̍sya yantā ||
english: O Indra, these many powers of yours — or your greatness, O Śakra, let them now speak forth. Those men who, like Manu, assemble at your side — be the guide of our fame, of our call.

sanskrit: śo̱śuce̍t puruṣo̱ na pra̍ti̱ dyu vi̍bhrā̱jaṁ śu̱kraṁ ta̍tane̱ hira̍ṇyam | ya śo̱śuca̍d ghṛ̱ta e̍bhiḥ sumedha pra ya̍d u̱ṣṭrā ā yo̍jā̱na ā va̍t ||
english: He has blazed like a man against the day, has spread brilliant, bright gold. He who blazes in ghee with these, of good wisdom — when the she-camels come forward, harnessed and dwelling in him.

sanskrit: yo ha̱vyavā̍ṭ pari̱bādhā̍ṁ navi̱ṣṭha a̱gni ri̍ri̱ce roda̍sī̱ anu̍ śukraḥ | sā tvī̍ṣāu sūna̱ve̍ śu̱kravarṇa̍sya sa ka̍viḥ sa pra̱tna ā bi̍bhāya ||
english: He who, bearing oblations, newest of the restrainers — the brilliant Agni has spread between the two worlds. That blazing one for the son of him of brilliant color — that seer, that ancient one, shines in awe.

sanskrit: eti̱ pra hotā̍ puru̱vāra̍ e̱ṣaḥ prati̍ vā̱ram ā ha̍ nu̱r yo viśā̍ṁsi̱ | yad ā̍su̱te mita̱vo no̍ arci̱ṣā bha̱rge na ṛ̍ṣ̍ṭiṁ ratha̱yūthi̱r ā yāt ||
english: The much-desired calling priest advances, truly invoked in turn against each desire — invoking the folk. When the measured flames blaze forth with their rays — may the chariot-team come with its spear as with brilliance.

sanskrit: ni̱ṣattvā̍ su̱mnaṁ ma̱nyo yā̍tavedhā̱ḥ u̍pa̱ste pa̍rṣad iṣu̱dhiḥ śa̍kra su̱tāṁ bhāgaṁ ya̍ccha su̱tāna̍ṁ bhāgaṁ | ta̱smā u̱ gāyo̱ vavrī̍hi̱r noda̍ eṣāṁ divaṁ su̱viṣṭaṁ bha̍ja ||
english: Sitting down, O resolute will-power — you who distribute good intent, stand beside the quiver of arrows; O Śakra, grant the share of the pressed one, the portion of the pressed Soma. Sing to him the cowherd songs; spur these on; grant a share of heaven well-entered.

sanskrit: a̱gniṁ hota̍ram ṛ̱ta yo̍ ni̱ṣatsad yo̍ni̱m ṛtasya̍ sa̱dhyata̍ḥ | ye gā̍yatri̱ya uta̍ tṛ̱ṣṭubhā̍ naro̍ bha̱jante̱ bṛha̱tī abhi̱ śriya̍m ||
english: Those men who celebrate Agni as the calling priest who has sat down by Ṛta, who is established by Ṛta in the womb — those who share in the Gāyatrī and Triṣṭubh meters partake of the Bṛhatī and its glory.

sanskrit: ya̱jñena̍ ya̱jñam āya̍jantas te me̱ indo̍ su̱tasya̍ pa̱nvat sa̍mdṛśaḥ | a̱gnir hi̍ ṣmā ya̱jñiyaṁ yājaya̍nti ma̱hān mahā̍bhiḥ stoma̱vāha̍ḥ ||
english: Those who, gaining the sacrifice by sacrifice — for me, O Indu, the sight of the pressed one comes in like rain. For Agni indeed carries the sacrifice-worthy one along in the sacrifice — the great one with the great ones, the carrier of hymns.

sanskrit: a̱gniḥ sthi̱raṁ ma̱ṇaṁ bha̍ra̱ d viśva̱m āyu̍r dī̱rghāyu̍tvā̱ya yajña̍m | a̱gnir de̱vān hara̍sā ca̱kṣaṁ ā̱pa u̱ṣā bha̍van prā̱tiśasta̍ naḥ ||
english: May Agni bear steady wealth and all life for long life and the sacrifice. May Agni look upon the gods with desire; may waters and Dawn become proclaimed for us.

sanskrit: a̱gniṁ viśvā̍ abhi̱ priyo̱ arci̍bhi̱ḥ su̱mnaṁ yuva̍ so viśya̱ḥ | di̱vo na yo̱niṁ ka̱dru ma̱hi vo̍ca̱s tatā̱ pṛthu̍ rādha̱s ta bhāga̍m ||
english: All of them, beloved, approach Agni with flames; the young man's good intent belongs to all the folk. May you speak of the great seat of heaven, the tawny-golden one — the broad wealth laid out, that share.

sanskrit: ū̱rjaṁ ca̍ sukṣi̱ti ca̱ pra na̍ḥ suvīra su̱mnā ya̍ntu su̱sumna̍ı̈r dhī̱bhi | ga̱hā ca̱ ta i̱ndra go̱mati̍ śravasy a̱smān vaje̍ṣu jā̱tave̍da ā̱vṛtā̍ ||
english: O hero of good deeds, let vigor and good dwelling come to us through most pleasant thoughts. Your hiding places rich in cattle and renown, O Indra — encompass us in the contests, O Jātavedas.

sanskrit: tvam a̍ṅgi̱raḥ pra̍tha̱maś ca̍ yo̱dhā de̱vānā̱m avo̍bhis tvirā̱ṇa ā̍ | ā su̍tā̱sya pī̱tim ā̱yā ta̍v asmā̱kam bodhi̍ su̱tānā̍m ||
english: You, O Aṅgiras, the first warrior — swiftly rousing the aides of the gods; come to the drinking of the pressed Soma; be of us, be for us of the pressed ones.

sanskrit: ya̍d aṅgiro nār̍danta viśva̱vāre̱ sam inda̍ve̱ param̐ ma̍rūto vi̱śve de̍vā a̱nu | e̱ṣa sya̍ sūri̱r adhva̍re va̱ṣaṭkṛ̱ta ā te̍ śaṁsā̱ apā̍ naghat ||
english: When, O Aṅgiras, all the Maruts and all the gods attend the Indu of all treasures, combined in the highest — this patron consecrated with 'Vaṣaṭ' at the ritual — may your praises never fail.

sanskrit: yo no̍ de̱va a̱ va hā̱r devy a̍gna u̱rve pṛthu̍ṣṭavā̱ya ṛti̱ṣīṣad a̍ntaḥ | a̱yam u̱ yor bha̍jeyur a̱mūra̍sya rā̱yas po̱ṣasya̍ ma̱ ghava̍n ṛ̱tāvā̍n ||
english: O divine Agni, O bright goddess — let the possessor of Ṛta sit within, within the wide and broadly praised — that he of truth may grant a share to this one and that of the wealth of the blameless one, the beneficent one who possesses Ṛta.

sanskrit: ā śī̱rṣṇā ya̍nti ja̍rayante̱ svāhā̍ ye ke ca̍ bhṛ̱guru̍ṣṭayo̱ no̍ manu̱ṣvat | te a̍gnī̱ṣomā̱ adha̍ra̱m̐ rā̍jatam no̱ vyoma̍n rakṣ̱o adhi̍ bhūmaṁ dadhātam ||
english: Going headlong with Svāhā-cries they come and wither away — any whose hostilities toward us burn fierce as Bhṛgu's. May Agni and Soma put those below us in the firmament and on the earth — protect us from the Rākṣasa.

sanskrit: sa̱hasra̍bharam pa̱ram i̍ndra rā̱yas po̱ṣam upa̍ no̱ yantaṁ ta̱nu hi̍ | a̱smāka̱m śarma̍n bha̍va ta̱ va ṣu va̍yo̱ rādha̱ Indo̍ kṛṇu pu̱rutamaṁ ca̍ no no bhava ||
english: O Indra, lead toward us the most excellent prosperity of wealth with a thousand gifts; extend it. Be our shelter; be our vigor — O Indu, make the boon most plentiful and be for us.

sanskrit: sa̱hasra̍daṁ śa̱tanī̍tham ma̱gho naṁ viśvā̍ abhi̱ priyo̱ jat ya̱nto | sa̱ tvam a̍ghora̱ ā ma̍ṁsathā uta̱ no va̱ndinaṁ vāja̍sātau śru̱dhi | naro ye viśvāḥ pra̍yato̱ rāty a̍ntar yāhi tvam ||
english: The generous one who gives thousands and leads hundreds — all beloved ones approaching him. You who are non-terrible — think of us too; hear the praiser in the prize-contest. Those heroes who are fully readied with generosity — go among them.

sanskrit: tvam i̍ndra viśvā̱ jan̍ā̱ na̍ a̱smi ti̱ṣṭhām o̍kasā̱ śāntā̍ṁ sa̱mīcī̍nāḥ | a̱sma yā̍ vṛ̱trahā̍ vṛ̱trahety a̱ s tyad dhinva̍na indra yā bhava̍ nty a̱nvag vā̍ ||
english: O Indra, all peoples — let none of us dwell quietly with calm neighbors. The Vṛtra-slayer — for us, as such — this word goes forth, O Indra; whatever becomes impelling, following in its wake.

sanskrit: pra su ta̍ sto̱treṇa̍ mahe̱ śruta̱ṁ na̱ḥ so̍maṁ pī̱tvā ja̍riṣṇū ā̱ yaś ca̍ babhūva | rā̱yā ci̱tra sa̍ śruta ma̱hī na̍ ā gā̱ asmā̱kaṁ bodhi̍ su̱tānā̍m ||
english: Drive forth with our hymn of praise toward what is great, what is heard — having drunk the Soma, invigorating, you who have been such. With brilliant wealth come near to us, O widely heard one; be for us who have pressed the Soma.

sanskrit: ā ta̍ṁ yu̱jaṁ va̍joḥ su̱ṣṭute̍ ra̱tho 'śno̱v indra̍ ya̱nt sa̱hasriṇa̍ḥ | śa̱kro ya̍sto ja̱nīnā̱m̐ upa̱ sto̍tṛ̱bhya ā di̍va̱ ā tmo̍ viśvasthā̱ man yā̍hi ||
english: The chariot of your yoke-companion for the prize comes, O Indra, bringing thousands at the good praise. The mighty one, leader of peoples — come to the praisers from the sky, come from all stations.

sanskrit: e̱ṣa nu̍ te sto̱tā yan̍ indra̱ hūyate̱ 'sminn a̍hann ma̱ghavan̍ viśvasthānaḥ | yad indra̱ rādhā̍ṁsi̱ maṁha̍mānaḥ kara̍t su̱toṣu̍ kara̱t ta e̍na ||
english: This is your praiser now, O Indra — he who is invoked in this day, O generous one, present everywhere. When, O Indra, you distribute your gifts at the pressed Soma — do that for him.

sanskrit: ā ya̍hi śu̱śrumā̍ hi te̱ sā no̱ vāci̍ śatakrituḥ | ā̱vavāca̍ ma̱ghaṁ punar e̱ta de̱vān anu̍ bhāga śo | rā̱yas po̱ṣam ā yā̍hi ||
english: Come — for we have heard; come to our calling, O you of a hundred deeds. He has announced the gift again; now come to the gods for the share. Come to the prosperity of wealth.

sanskrit: sa̱hā̱nūka̍ḥ sa̱hauri̍r ha̱rvā iva̍ vṛ̱dhā a̱gniś ci̍t sā̱yaka̍ ā̱ ga̍meyam | na yo̍ vi̱do ya̱jiṣṭho̍ ha̱viṣmā̱n te de̱vānā̱ṁ su̍ṣū̱dayaṁ su̱tānā̍m ||
english: He who is together with his favorable ones, the allied force like a ram increasing — even Agni with arrows may I come. He who knows no equal, most worthy of sacrifice, bearer of oblations — I press forward the pressing of the gods' pressed Soma.

sanskrit: sa su̍ṣṭu̱tī ra̍tha̱yū yo̍ rathī̱nā ha̱riṇī̍m iṣum ṛ̱dhak pa̱ṇīnā̍m | indrā̍ya soma̱pāya̍ śurabhā no̍ bha̱rate̱ tad ā kṛ̍dhī ||
english: The good hymn — he who is the charioteer of charioteers, in its separate golden arrow of the Paṇis — bring that to Indra the Soma-drinker, fragrant for us; do make it so.

sanskrit: ya̱d id a̍ha̱ yāvan̍ purū̱ṇy asmān̍ viśvo̱ na̍Ātreyaṁ vṛ̱kṣam a̍stha̱t | śū̱ro yo du̱rdharo̍ bha̱vān hi̱tvā ta e̍ṣā̱m aja̍hāt tiro̱ divi̍ ||
english: Whatever and however many — all of us, like every Ātreya approaching a tree, have stood before him; he who is the hero, hard to restrain, the powerful one — leaving those behind, he abandoned them beyond the sky.

sanskrit: ta̱d u̍ ṣu te mahimā̱nam̐ ā stu̍hi̱ yad īm̐ hi̱nvā̍ na̍ kṣiya̱ṇt pi̱bāt so̍mam | indu̍m suṣṭu̱tī ra̱thir a̍ya̱n na nava̍ rathe̍ṣu ya̱jama̍nāḥ ke cid āsuḥ ||
english: Praise that greatness of his too — that, urged on, he drinks the Soma without dwelling still. The charioteer drives Indu with good praise — certain sacrificers were in the new chariots.

sanskrit: tad āhu̱r vavre̍ pu̱ru ca̱nd apa̍śyad ya̱d vi̱śvā vṛ̱tras tama̍so̱ apī̍te̱r āsā̍ vṛ̱ṇvāna̱ pari̍ iti̱ṣṭha ā̱po da̍dṛ̱kṣe su̍riṇīr jā̱yatā̍m iti ||
english: They say: in the enclosure the far-shining one saw — when Vṛtra covered all things before the undoing of darkness, standing around, covering with his mouth the waters — 'Let the streams be seen, let them arise!'

sanskrit: a̱smā u̱ asya̍ mahimā̱naṁ stuhi̍ yā̱bhi svar̍ṇā̱ṁ ā sam̱idha̱ sabhā̍ | vi yaj jāre̍ṇa̱ yoṣa̍ṇaḥ su̱vāsaso̍ yoṣa̱ṇo na̍ suvā̱sasa̍ḥ ||
english: Praise his greatness for him too — the praises by which the kindling of golden fires is assembled. When the well-dressed women with their lover — like well-dressed women.

sanskrit: tad id āha̱ḥ puru̱ṣaṁ ya̍smai ka̱vī upa̱ śikṣa̍taṁ vā̱yunā̍ vā̱yunā̍ | a̱gniṁ yor vi̱tatiṁ yat ku̍rvathe̱ sa̱hasri̍ṇaṁ pu̱rudhā̍ pṛ̱kṣyam̍ ||
english: This indeed has been said: to whichever man the two seers teach with understanding — when you two make the extension of Agni thousandfold, manifold, to be grasped.

sanskrit: a̱smā u̱ tad indra ta̱ṁ na sthira̱m̐ stu̍hi ya̱ś ce̍tati̱ ṛtu̍bhi̱ḥ kṣam̍ | pūru̍ṣāḍhirā̱ja ya̍sya̱ ū̍rjam puṣya̱ ma̱ṇa ma̍nasyuḥ ||
english: Praise also for him this one, O Indra — this firm one who discerns with his seasons the earth: he who is the great ruler of peoples, whose vigor the wise one, the inspired one, wishes to nourish.

sanskrit: a̱smai u̍grāya taviṣa̱ṁ su ta̍kṣaṇ vāja̱sātā̍v i̱nd rata̍ sū̱nṛtā̍bhiḥ | tvaṁ hi̍ ṣmā̱ puru̍tamo̱ jana̍sya kra̱tū ra̱yīr iva̍ su̱mādi̍ etu no̱ dhān ||
english: For this fierce, mighty one let the prize-winner be well fashioned at the prize-contest, O Indra, through words of truth. For you are the most pious one of the people — may riches come to us like joyful intentions and the capacity of action.

sanskrit: sa̱hasri̍ṇaṁ ma̱ghava̍nn indra su̱ṣṭutaṁ ra̍yiṁ soma̱pāta̍maṁ bibharṣi | yo ya̍jñiyā̱bhi sa̍ṁgṛ̱hīta̱ḥ sam i̍ndra ya̍si surī̱ḥ ||
english: You bear, O generous Indra, well-hymned thousandfold wealth, most blessed with Soma-drinking — you who are gathered together with the sacrificial ones, O Indra, and are marshaled with your patrons.

sanskrit: ā no̍ bhara sumatim agne no mahīm uta̍ | pra sto̱tṛbhyo̱ yatho̍ctham uta̱ tad a̍syāsi magha̱vā pu̱ruṣṭu̍taḥ ||
english: Bring to us, O Agni, great good thought for us; lead forth the praisers as you have been told. You are also the generous one among them, the much-praised.

sanskrit: vi̱śva i̍ndra su̱matī̍r ā̱ kṣa̱y asā̱d asmā̱kam bodhi̍ go̱pā | ā ta̍ indra tuvikra̱to ra̱yiḥ śa̱tam purū̍ṇy agā̱n nir ṛ̱ṣe ga̱vām̐ upa̍ ||
english: O Indra, may all acts of good intention abide in our dwelling; be our protector. O Indra, O you of great heroic power — let a hundred riches, many in number, come, streaming forth from the cows.

sanskrit: ā rā̱dhāya̍ ma̱hā a̍śnuta̱ ṇmad upa̍ tvā yo̱dha vi̱datha̍ hā | a̱smāka̱m bodhi̍ go̱pā ta̱ va yu̱jā yo̱dhā vi̱dathe̍ sū̱rebhi̍ḥ ||
english: To attain the great one, the rejoicing one, O warrior, come near, come to the assembly. Be our protector; with your allies, a warrior in the assembly with the heroes.

sanskrit: ā tvā̱ vṛdha̱ntu to̱kyā̱ ā su̍tāso̱ mad a̱ndhasa̍ḥ | tvaṁ naḥ śakra̍ go̱pā bha̍va sa̱pra̍tha iṣuyā̱ va̍r āśuṣe̱ sūri̱r na dhī̍ḥ ||
english: May your offspring increase you, may the pressed exhilarating juices increase you. Be our herdsman, O Śakra, of wide fame, shooting arrows, speeding — the patron's thought.

sanskrit: pra su bra̍hma̱ṇī̍ bṛha̱tī sa̱ṁsthitā̍ viśvā̱ vācā̍m upa̱ māsā̍ agā̱ḥ | indra̍sya soma̱pā a̍vase̱ hya̍sta̱ṁ tā a̱śva ini̍ndrā̱ya ca̍kram ||
english: The mighty prayer, the great one, is set in place; with all your speech the months have come toward you. The Soma-drinker — for Indra's aid; yesterday, the two horses were the wheel for Indra.

sanskrit: tvaṁ magha̍van su̱matīr a̍sme̱ dhā ru̍jāno̱ vṛtrā̍ jaritre̱ su̱ṣṭuta̍ḥ | vi̱śva i̍ndra rā̱ya ā̍ bha̱ja ma̱ghavam̐ stave̍na su̱ṣṭuta̍ḥ ||
english: O generous one, establish good intentions among us — breaking open fortresses, you are well praised for your singer. O Indra, share all wealth with the generous one, well praised with song.

sanskrit: ā tv a̍khya̱d adhi̍ pi̱tuḥ sa̍dha̱sthe pa̱tnīr viśvā̱ ā ci̍taya̍d vā̱yum | i̱ndra e̍ko a̱rva̍ṇi sa̱ptadhā̍tuṁ na ha̱nti yo̍dhā̱ya te̍ sama̱ryam ||
english: He saw from the station of his father and aroused all the wives and Vāyu. Indra alone, in the race with sevenfold substance — he does not strike the one who is not a warrior fit for your battle.

sanskrit: a̱smā u̱ tad indra̍sya na̱u vye̍tad u̱pa ya̍d eti̱ viśvam ā pra̍ bhūṣa | a̱dha ṣvid ya̱d vasya̍nta̱ā śarā̍ṇ vi̱śveṣāṁ da̍dāti kaṁ su̱tānā̍m ||
english: For him, for Indra — and for us, let this come forth abundantly, whatever approaches all pervading. Now indeed, when the arrows of wealth fly — he bestows something from all the pressed ones.

sanskrit: i̱maṁ ya̱jñam ima̍ṁ su̱tam indrā̱ya bha̱ram̐ namaḥ | a̱yam stome̍bhi̱r vidhya̍ti śru̱tam na̍ḥ svaro̱ janā̍n ||
english: This sacrifice, this pressed Soma — bring it to Indra with homage. Let this one, with hymns, pierce through and make our well-known shout reach the peoples.

sanskrit: e̱tad u̍ tye a̍bravīt pu̱rū abhi yat sa̱haḥ | indrā̍ya soma̱pāta̍māya vi̱śvān ā̍ ja̱bhāra bhu̍va̱nasya̱ rājan̍ ||
english: This is what those many have spoken, against his power: for Indra who drinks Soma most fully — the king of the world has seized all things.

sanskrit: a̱smā u̱ ta i̍ndra dā̱na e̍ṣāṁ ma̱ghava̍n nara̱ḥ | bha̱jema̍ sūra̱ṇāsa̍ḥ su̱tānā̍m ṛ̱tasya̍ dharmāṇi ||
english: O Indra, for him and for us may we — the generous heroes — share in the gift of these; of the pressed ones, the laws of Ṛta, heroic in our resolve.

sanskrit: i̱ndraḥ su̱trāmā̍ su̱kutra̍ḥ su̱pāṇiḥ ka̍lyā̱ṇa go̍ṣu dhi̱yā dā̱tā | sa no̍ vi̱śvāyu̍r deva̱ poṣā̍ṁsi̱ viśvā̍ sū̱ri ra̱ṣṭra ā bha̍ja ||
english: Indra the good protector, with good guidance, with beautiful hands — in cattle a good giver by design. May he, all-living, divine — share with us all nourishments, the patron's kingdom.

sanskrit: su̱trāmā̍ṇam pṛthu̱rādha̍sam | ind̥ ram ī̱ḷiṣe̍ sa śa̱taṁ ya̱jñā a̱smā u̍ śa̱tau vi̍ jā̱yata̱ indra̱ṁ na ye 'rati̍ṁ jā̱ta ape̍ śa̱tau vi̱ jāya̍tā ||
english: The good protector of wide bounty — Indra I beseech; a hundred sacrifices — and for him a hundred more; may Indra be victorious. Those who are not zealous for him — born to fail, may they be defeated in the contest.

sanskrit: śuci̱ṁ nu a̍stam̐ ḥ śu̱nāya̍ dru̱hvaṇe̍ yujyā̱ yakṣa̍d indro yo̱dhāya̍ | apa̱ śveta̍sya vṛṣa̱bhasya̱ māyā̍ḥ kṛ̱ṣṇasya̍ vi̱śvādi̍va̱ṁ sā ta̍ vidyāt ||
english: Now the bright one turns it homeward for the treacherous, wretched one — may Indra yoke for the battle. Away from the white bull's deceits; from Kṛṣṇa's — may all of that know heaven.

sanskrit: sva̱rṇa u̱ te ma̱ṁhane̍ śa̱taṁ nṛ̱bhya upa̱ dhura̍ṁ dha̱d a̱sminn a̍hann u ta | pra ta̍v indra māya̱vinā̍m avā̱c chuci̱ṁ nu ya̍ntu dakṣi̱ṇā a̱po na pra̍va̱ṇā iṣe̍ ||
english: Indeed your golden gift for a hundred men places the yoke today in this day too. Before you, O Indra, let the bright gifts of the deceivers now go downward — like waters flowing downward to the nourishment.

sanskrit: ud ī̱rṣvā hi̍ no rāya̍ṁ sū̱ri su̱mnasya̍ mā̱ma ne̱ | upa̍ dra̱vo vi̱do̱ viśo̱ 'pā vṛ̍ṇīmahe ||
english: Rise up, O patron, for our wealth; do not neglect the good disposition of the mind. Come rushing toward those clans who know; we draw away the waters.

sanskrit: a̱pa dra̱vo vi̱do̱ viśo̱ yāsāṁ deva̍tāsu me | indra̱ṁ na ye ya̱ji ṣṭha̱ṁ na pu̍ṣyā̱t ta̱ e̍ṣāṁ dhī̱r a̱pā va̍ ||
english: Drive away those knowing clans with whose divine powers I am not — those whose thought for Indra, as for the most sacrifice-worthy one, does not prosper — drive them away.

sanskrit: a̱sme u̱ ta tā̍nu̱hi na̍mo̱ bhya in̥ dra̱ jyo ti̍ṣe | vi̱śvā su̍ṣṭu̱ti vā̍ rā̱ya i̱ṣa indo pra va̍rdhaya ||
english: Extend for us homage, O Indra, for light. With all good praise or riches — O Indu, make the nourishment grow.

sanskrit: ni̱ṣka̍ṇvaṁ dvi̱pā̍ṁ ca̍tus̱pāṁ viśvā bhu̍va̱nā ā ra̍bhasva | yat te̱ bhadra̱mā su̱mnāya̍ va reyā̱ṁ a̍sme ta̱d ā bha̍ra vā̱yu viśva̍bheda namaḥ ||
english: O Niṣkaṇva, seize all beings two-footed and four-footed. Whatever good there is for you — for gracious intent — O Vāyu, Viśvabheda, bring that best thing to us; homage.

sanskrit: vāyo̍ yukṣvā̱ hi ke̍śinā̱ rathā̍ya ke̱śinā̱ hariṁ ha̍riṁ yo ju̱gū̱ha su̱tānā̍m pī̱tim arha̍si su̱tānā̍m pī̱tim a̍rhasi | vi̱śveṣā̍m adha̱riṁ hu̍taṁ de̱veṣu̍ jūjuvaḥ priyo̍ bhava vā̱yav ā̍ ga̍hi ||
english: O Vāyu, yoke the two tawny-maned ones to the chariot — the tawny, tawny ones he has covered; you deserve the drinking of the pressed Soma, you deserve the drinking of the pressed Soma. You have urged on the oblation poured below among all, among the gods; be beloved; O Vāyu, come here.

sanskrit: vāyo̍ ye te̱ sahasri̍ṇo̱ rathā̍so dhṛṣṇo̱ niyuto̱ hariṁ ha̍rim asya̱ntu su̱tānā̍m pī̱tim arha̍si su̱tānā̍m pī̱tim a̍rhasi | a̱chā somi̍nam a̱gnim ā va̍hantū̱tā vā̱yum pra yo̍dhantu jiṣṇave̍ namaḥ ||
english: O Vāyu, O bold one, may your thousands of chariots with their teams of tawny horses swoop to us — tawny after tawny; you deserve the drinking of the pressed Soma, you deserve the drinking of the pressed Soma. May they carry hither the Soma-presser, the fire — and spur Vāyu forward for the conquering one; homage.

sanskrit: vāyo̍ ye te̍ satānī̱ka yo̱dhāso̱ niyuto̱ hariṁ ha̍rim a̱gre su̱tānā̍m pī̱tim arha̍si su̱tānā̍m pī̱tim a̍rhasi | a̱yaṁ su̍tā̱so ma̍dhuma̱nto a̍dri̱bhiḥ śyenā̍so na̱ pāta̱yanta̱ḥ su̱tānā̍m ||
english: O Vāyu, your warriors of a hundred fronts, with teams of tawny horses, in front — you deserve the drinking of the pressed Soma, you deserve the drinking of the pressed Soma. These pressed ones, sweet with honey, pressed on stones — like eagles they fly down — of the pressed ones.

sanskrit: vāyo̍ yaś ci̍tram uktha̱yā su̱tānā̍m pī̱tim ā ya̍hi su̱tānā̍m pī̱tim ā ya̍hi | sūno̱ ha̱viṣ ṭe̍ avase̱ pra ya̍ntā viśvā su̱mnaṁ ya̍jama̱nāya̍ dhehi ||
english: O Vāyu, you who are brilliant for the hymn — come to the drinking of the pressed Soma, come to the drinking of the pressed Soma. May the son's oblation go forth for your aid; establish all good things for the sacrificer.

sanskrit: tvaṁ no̍ vāyav eṣā̱m uta̍ pūrva̱sya ya̱te su̱tānā̍m pī̱tim a̍rhasi su̱tānā̍m pī̱tim a̍rhasi | u̱to vi̱śveṣv a̍dhva̱reṣu̱ cano̍ dhā̱ḥ su̱tānā̍m pa̱nthaṁ yas te̱ priyo̍ va̱yo dhā̍ḥ ||
english: O Vāyu, you deserve the drinking of these pressed Soma-drops and also of the former one, you deserve the drinking of the pressed Soma, you deserve the drinking of the pressed Soma. Moreover at all the rituals may you set your pleasure; set the path of the pressed ones that is dear to you, your vital food.

sanskrit: tvaṁ no̍ vāyav eṣā̱m apū̍rvya̱ḥ somā̍nām pratha̱maḥ pī̱tim a̍rhasi su̱tānā̍m pī̱tim a̍rhasi | u̱to vi̱hutma̍tīnāṁ vi̱śāṁ va̍va̱rjuṣī̍ṇām | viśvā̱ it te̍ dhe̱navo̍ duhra ā̱śira̱ṁ ghṛ̱taṁ du̍hrata ā̱śira̍m ||
english: O Vāyu, you who are peerless — you deserve the first drinking of these Soma draughts, you deserve the drinking of the pressed Soma. Moreover, of the clans with wide-scattering impulse, who have been set apart — all your milch-cows yield the mixture with ghee, they yield the admixture with ghee.

sanskrit: stī̱rṇam ba̱rhir upa̍ no yāhi vī̱taye̍ sa̱hasre̍ṇa ni̱yutā̍ niyutvate śa̱tinī̍bhir niyutvate | tubhya̱ṁ hi pū̱rvapī̍taye de̱vā de̱vāya̍ yemi̱re | pra te̍ su̱tāso̱ madhu̍manto asthira̱n madā̍ya̱ kratve̍ asthiran ||
english: The sacred grass is strewn — come to us for the feast, O Vāyu, with a thousand steeds in your team, with a hundred in your team. For to you the gods have extended the first drinking, O god among gods. Forth have your pressed, sweet Soma-draughts stood ready — they have stood ready for exhilaration and for action.

sanskrit: tubhyā̱yaṁ soma̱ḥ pari̍pūto̱ adri̍bhiḥ spā̱rhā vasā̍na̱ḥ pari̱ kośa̍m arṣati śu̱krā vasā̍no arṣati | tavā̱yam bhā̱ga ā̱yuṣu̱ somo̍ de̱veṣu̍ hūyate | vaha̍ vāyo ni̱yuto̍ yāhy asma̱yur ju̍ṣā̱ṇo yā̍hy asma̱yuḥ ||
english: For you this Soma flows around, strained through the stones — desirable, clothed in beauty, it flows around the vessel, clothed in brilliance it flows. This Soma is your share, invoked among the gods among living beings. Drive here, O Vāyu, with your team — come desiring us, come desiring us with joy.

sanskrit: ā no̍ ni̱yudbhi̍ḥ śa̱tinī̍bhir adhva̱raṁ sa̍ha̱sriṇī̍bhi̱r upa̍ yāhi vī̱taye̱ vāyo̍ ha̱vyāni̍ vī̱taye̍ | tavā̱yam bhā̱ga ṛ̱tviya̱ḥ sara̍śmi̱ḥ sūrye̱ sacā̍ | a̱dhva̱ryubhi̱r bhara̍māṇā ayaṁsata̱ vāyo̍ śu̱krā a̍yaṁsata ||
english: Come to our ritual with your teams of hundreds, of thousands — O Vāyu, come for the feast; come for the oblations. This your share is seasonal, following the Sun's rays. Borne by the Adhvaryus, they have been arranged, O Vāyu — the bright ones have been arranged.

sanskrit: ā vā̱ṁ ratho̍ ni̱yutvā̍n vakṣa̱d ava̍se̱ 'bhi prayā̍ṁsi̱ sudhi̍tāni vī̱taye̱ vāyo̍ ha̱vyāni̍ vī̱taye̍ | piba̍ta̱m madhvo̱ andha̍saḥ pūrva̱peya̱ṁ hi vā̍ṁ hi̱tam | vāya̱v ā ca̱ndreṇa̱ rādha̱sā ga̍ta̱m indra̍ś ca̱ rādha̱sā ga̍tam ||
english: May the chariot with its team bring you two here for aid, toward the well-laid out enjoyments — O Vāyu, for the feast, for the oblations. Drink of the sweet juice — to you belongs the first drinking. O Vāyu, come with gleaming bounty, and Indra too — come with bounty.

sanskrit: ā vā̱ṁ dhiyo̍ vavṛtyur adhva̱rām̐ upe̱mam indu̍m marmṛjanta vā̱jina̍m ā̱śum atya̱ṁ na vā̱jina̍m | teṣā̍m pibatam asma̱yū ā no̍ gantam i̱hotyā | indra̍vāyū su̱tānā̱m adri̍bhir yu̱vam madā̍ya vājadā yu̱vam ||
english: May our prayers have turned the two of you toward the ritual; they have polished this swift Indu like a prize-winning, swift steed. Drink of those, desiring us — come here today. O Indravāyu, you two, of the pressed ones pressed with stones, for exhilaration — you two the prize-givers.

sanskrit: i̱me vā̱ṁ somā̍ a̱psv ā su̱tā i̱hādhva̱ryubhi̱r bhara̍māṇā ayaṁsata̱ vāyo̍ śu̱krā a̍yaṁsata | e̱te vā̍m a̱bhy a̍sṛkṣata ti̱raḥ pa̱vitra̍m ā̱śava̍ḥ | yu̱vā̱yavo 'ti̱ romā̍ṇy a̱vyayā̱ somā̍so̱ aty a̱vyayā̍ ||
english: These Soma draughts pressed for you two in the waters here — borne by the Adhvaryus they have been arranged, O Vāyu; the bright ones have been arranged. These have been let flow toward you two through the filter, swiftly. Like eager young men passing through the wool of the sheep — the Soma draughts passing through the wool.

sanskrit: ati̍ vāyo sasa̱to yā̍hi̱ śaśva̍to̱ yatra̱ grāvā̱ vada̍ti̱ tatra̍ gacchataṁ gṛ̱ham indra̍ś ca gacchatam | vi sū̱nṛtā̱ dadṛ̍śe̱ rīya̍te ghṛ̱tam ā pū̱rṇayā̍ ni̱yutā̍ yātho adhva̱ram indra̍ś ca yātho adhva̱ram ||
english: O Vāyu, pass by those who ever sleep; where the pressing stone speaks — go there, to that house; Indra too shall go there. Truth-speech has been seen; ghee flows; come to the ritual with your full team, O Vāyu, and Indra come to the ritual.

sanskrit: atrāha̱ tad va̍hethe̱ madhva̱ āhu̍ti̱ṁ yam a̍śva̱ttham u̍pa̱tiṣṭha̍nta jā̱yavo̱ 'sme te sa̍ntu jā̱yava̍ḥ | sā̱kaṁ gāva̱ḥ suva̍te̱ pacya̍te̱ yavo̱ na te̍ vāya̱ upa̍ dasyanti dhe̱navo̱ nāpa̍ dasyanti dhe̱nava̍ḥ ||
english: Here indeed carry this sweet oblation — the one that the wives attend under the aśvattha-tree; may those wives be ours. Together the cows give birth, the barley is cooked; O Vāyu, your milch-cows do not fall short, the milch-cows do not fail.

sanskrit: i̱me ye te̱ su vā̍yo bā̱hvo̍jaso̱ 'ntar na̱dī te̍ pa̱taya̍nty u̱kṣaṇo̱ mahi̱ vrādha̍nta u̱kṣaṇa̍ḥ | dhanva̍ñ ci̱d ye a̍nā̱śavo̍ jī̱rāś ci̱d agi̍raukasaḥ | sūrya̍syeva ra̱śmayo̍ durni̱yanta̍vo̱ hasta̍yor durni̱yanta̍vaḥ ||
english: These who are yours, O Vāyu, of strong-armed power — bulls fly in the rivers between them, the bulls swell greatly. Even on the desert plain those who are tireless, those swift ones dwelling on the mountain: like the rays of the Sun, hard to restrain in the hands — hard to restrain in the hands.
